costPrinciples: Solana base fee 5000 lamports per transaction signature plus optional priority fee.
Creation of an absent RVIV ATA requires rent; paying for a recipient ATA gives the rent to that account, not back to the sender.
Use existing recipient token accounts where valid and supported; avoid unnecessary ATA creation.
Squads transfer/proposal costs and current rent are live values, not a fixed quoted minimum.
Batch transfers can group approvals while executing multiple onchain transactions; one click is not one atomic transaction.
